requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
About the Company/Team
The Global Finance Information Center (GFIC) supports centralized finance operations. Within Accounts Receivable, the Cash Applications function manages customer-payment activities and helps ensure receipts are accurately identified, applied, reconciled, and reflected against the appropriate customer invoices.
This position supports LAD countries and works closely with customers, Collections, Accounts Receivable, Sales, and other internal teams to resolve payment-application issues and maintain accurate customer accounts.
